title: GrowerHub news — new features and updates
heading: GrowerHub news
description: New app features, useful guides and fixes. See what changed and how to try it.

entries.text: Rewrote the green pumpkin guide, from the harvest on the kitchen table to the winter shelf, with simpler language and a warmer voice.
The editorial team can now publish growing guides without automatic demo or device connection prompts. The article text, sources and links to related guides remain available.

Fixed sensor readings through PushOk: temperature, humidity and other measurements with a supported format now use the driver's units and can be assigned to greenhouses. Removed spurious decimal digits introduced during conversion. Unknown conversions no longer pass raw numbers to automations.
A device without a PushOk driver no longer interrupts device list and reading updates. It remains listed without controls, while supported sensors and sockets continue to work.
Fixed receiving bot commands when Telegram cannot initiate a connection to the server. Journal linking and reminder buttons use the same bot.
The plant journal guide now covers the timeline, search, phone photos and starting without hardware.
The photo diary guide now explains image uploads, date edits and starting without hardware.
Article headings, text, links and demo invitations are easier to read on the light background, including on phones.
The scheduled watering guide now uses the current Farm and Routines labels and save steps, with updated editor screenshots in Russian and English.

The app now shares the website’s light lilac style, with more readable labels and simpler Farm and Routines navigation. The overview, plants, charts and forms have been refreshed; existing actions and settings are preserved.

The catalog and guide now include a 499 RUB soil sensor, a 1,999 RUB pump and a 2,499 RUB pump with 20 drippers and tubing. Order them separately or with a kit through the basket. The pump supports Wi-Fi without a Zigbee coordinator or Zigbee; contents and first setup are discussed by phone.
The microclimate history article now includes a small nursery example: one seedling zone, a daily chart, a follow-up inspection and connection limits.
Publication checks no longer report an error when new articles are added. Missing pages and translations are still detected.
The Home Assistant watering guide now explains MQTT connector compatibility, access scope and a first sensor check while existing HA automations stay in charge.
Clarified the English label for manual watering until leak detection.
Zigbee2MQTT connector v0.2.5 preserves library version information for device command compatibility checks. Updating is optional and does not enable irrigation.
The guide now links to the current connector ZIP and explains updating from v0.2.4 while keeping your personal configuration file.
The watering plan guide now explains available rain handling: outdoor precipitation, bounded delays and an explicit policy for unavailable forecasts.
Watering schedules now show English weekday abbreviations. Tuesday is no longer displayed as a power unit.
The watering plan refreshes after settings are saved. The previous plan is no longer shown as current while the new one loads.
Watering device cards direct you to a bounded session through the greenhouse. The off button remains available.
A new page opens at the top when you follow a menu or article link. Back navigation and section links retain their usual behaviour.
The watering log guide now explains measured, estimated and unknown water volumes.
